description: Issue #58 (PROPOSED, not yet finalized): `successes` requires `trials`. A numerator without its denominator is exactly the unreadable-rate failure this proposal exists to prevent, so it is rejected. This rule IS expressible in plain JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12 `dependentRequired: {"successes": ["trials"]}` on the grader_results item), so spec/schemas/resultset.json and the hand-rolled SDK validators agree; the hand-rolled validators report REQUIRED at the missing `trials` path. A conforming validator MUST REJECT this document.
